name: Luchik zhizni
source:
Young Misha dreams of having a pet, but all his parents' attempts to get him cats, dogs and even fish turned out to be in vain. However, a solution is found, and the boy asks his parents to give him a robo-dog...

Yes, we agree, it sounds too optimistic and naive. But then what if the purchase of such a difficult toy causes discord in the family and leads to a not too happy ending?

[translated from [url=https://orbllits.itch.io/ray-of-life]itch.io[/url]]
